reservations_caution_recue_check.name: reservations_caution_recue_check
reservations_caution_recue_check.value:
("reservations"."caution_recue_at" is null or "reservations"."moyen_caution" in ('cheque', 'virement'))
          and ("reservations"."caution_rendue_at" is null or "reservations"."caution_recue_at" is not null)

reservations_mode_solde_check.name: reservations_mode_solde_check
reservations_mode_solde_check.value:
"reservations"."mode_solde" is null or ("reservations"."mode_solde" in ('prelevement', 'lien')
          and not "reservations"."paiement_integral"
          and ("reservations"."mode_solde" = 'lien' or "reservations"."moyen_caution" = 'carte'))

paiements_remboursement_check.name: paiements_remboursement_check
paiements_remboursement_check.value: "paiements"."statut" not in ('a_rembourser', 'rembourse') or "paiements"."motif_remboursement" is not null

paiements_caution_check.name: paiements_caution_check
paiements_caution_check.value:
"paiements"."type" = 'caution' or ("paiements"."statut" not in ('bloque', 'libere', 'retenu')
          and "paiements"."expire_at" is null and "paiements"."montant_retenu" is null and "paiements"."date_liberation" is null)

paiements_retenue_check.name: paiements_retenue_check
paiements_retenue_check.value:
("paiements"."statut" = 'retenu') = ("paiements"."montant_retenu" is not null)
          and ("paiements"."montant_retenu" is null or ("paiements"."montant_retenu" > 0 and "paiements"."montant_retenu" <= "paiements"."montant"))

reglages_bebes_check.name: reglages_bebes_check
reglages_bebes_check.value:
"reglages"."bebe_age_limite" between 1 and 17 and "reglages"."bebes_hors_capacite" between 0 and 10
          and "reglages"."lits_bebe" between 0 and 10

reglages_paiement_check.name: reglages_paiement_check
reglages_paiement_check.value:
"reglages"."taux_acompte" between 1 and 100 and "reglages"."delai_solde_jours" between 0 and 365
          and "reglages"."delai_virement_caution_jours" between 0 and 60

reglages_suivi_check.name: reglages_suivi_check
reglages_suivi_check.value:
"reglages"."suivi_validite_jours" between 0 and 3650 and "reglages"."suivi_demandes_max" between 1 and 100
          and "reglages"."suivi_demandes_minutes" between 1 and 10080

reglages_avis_check.name: reglages_avis_check
reglages_avis_check.value:
("reglages"."avis_note_centiemes" is null) = ("reglages"."avis_nombre" is null)
          and ("reglages"."avis_note_centiemes" is null or "reglages"."avis_note_centiemes" between 0 and 500)
          and ("reglages"."avis_nombre" is null or "reglages"."avis_nombre" >= 0)
          and ("reglages"."avis_recommandation_pct" is null or "reglages"."avis_recommandation_pct" between 0 and 100)

reglages_solde_check.name: reglages_solde_check
reglages_solde_check.value:
"reglages"."solde_preavis_jours" between 0 and 60 and "reglages"."solde_lien_jours" between 0 and 60
          and "reglages"."solde_rappel_jours" between 0 and 60 and "reglages"."solde_relance_jours" between 1 and 60

reglages_virement_check.name: reglages_virement_check
reglages_virement_check.value:
("reglages"."virement_titulaire" is null) = ("reglages"."virement_iban" is null)
          and ("reglages"."virement_titulaire" is null or length(trim("reglages"."virement_titulaire")) > 0)
          and ("reglages"."virement_iban" is null or "reglages"."virement_iban" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}[A-Z0-9]{11,30}$')
          and ("reglages"."virement_bic" is null or "reglages"."virement_bic" ~ '^[A-Z]{6}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?$')
          and "reglages"."virement_courriel_jours" between 0 and 60

reglages_gestion_check.name: reglages_gestion_check
reglages_gestion_check.value:
"reglages"."gestion_appareil_jours" between 1 and 365 and "reglages"."gestion_inactivite_heures" between 1 and 168
          and "reglages"."gestion_essais_max" between 1 and 20 and "reglages"."gestion_attente_minutes" between 1 and 1440
          and "reglages"."gestion_code_minutes" between 1 and 60 and "reglages"."gestion_lien_minutes" between 5 and 1440

taxes_sejour_parametres_check.name: taxes_sejour_parametres_check
taxes_sejour_parametres_check.value:
("taxes_sejour"."mode" = 'proportionnel' and "taxes_sejour"."taux" is not null and "taxes_sejour"."plafond" is not null)
          or ("taxes_sejour"."mode" = 'fixe' and "taxes_sejour"."tarif_fixe" is not null)

taxes_sejour_valeurs_check.name: taxes_sejour_valeurs_check
taxes_sejour_valeurs_check.value:
("taxes_sejour"."taux" is null or "taxes_sejour"."taux" > 0) and ("taxes_sejour"."plafond" is null or "taxes_sejour"."plafond" > 0)
          and ("taxes_sejour"."tarif_fixe" is null or "taxes_sejour"."tarif_fixe" >= 0) and "taxes_sejour"."taxe_additionnelle" >= 0

courriels_envoye_check.name: courriels_envoye_check
courriels_envoye_check.value: "courriels"."statut" <> 'envoye' or ("courriels"."envoye_at" is not null and "courriels"."voie" is not null and "courriels"."sujet" is not null)
